006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.IDataTypeAdapter;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidTypeFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
013
014import java.util.stream.Stream;
015
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * The base interface inherited by all Metapath item implementations.
020 */
021public interface IItem extends ICollectionValue {
022  /**
023   * Get the type information for this item.
024   *
025   * @return the type information
026   */
027  @NonNull
028  static IItemType type() {
029    return IItemType.item();
030  }
031
032  /**
033   * Get the type information for the item.
034   *
035   * @return the item's type information
036   */
037  @NonNull
038  IItemType getType();
039
040  /**
041   * Get the item's "wrapped" value. This "wrapped" value may be:
042   * <ul>
043   * <li>In the case of an Assembly, a Java object representing the fields and
044   * flags of the assembly.
045   * <li>In the case of a Field with flags, a Java object representing the field
046   * value and flags of the field.
047   * <li>In the case of a Field without flags or a flag, a Java type managed by a
048   * {@link IDataTypeAdapter} or a primitive type provided by the Java standard
049   * library.
050   * </ul>
051   *
052   * @return the value or {@code null} if the item has no available value
053   */
054  Object getValue();
055
056  /**
057   * Determine if the item has an associated value.
058   *
059   * @return {@code true} if the item has a non-{@code null} value or
060   *         {@code false} otherwise
061   */
062  default boolean hasValue() {
063    return getValue() != null;
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  default ISequence<?> toSequence() {
068    return ISequence.of(this);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Get the atomic value for the item. This may be the same item if the item is
073   * an instance of {@link IAnyAtomicItem}.
074   * <p>
075   * An implementation of
076   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-atomization">item
077   * atomization</a>.
078   *
079   * @return the atomic value or {@code null} if the item has no available value
080   * @throws InvalidTypeFunctionException
081   *           with code
082   *           {@link InvalidTypeFunctionException#NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE} if the
083   *           item does not have a typed value
084   */
085  // FIXME: get rid of the possible null result and throw
086  // InvalidTypeFunctionException#NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE
087  IAnyAtomicItem toAtomicItem();
088
089  /**
090   * {@inheritDoc}
091   *
092   * @throws InvalidTypeFunctionException
093   *           with code
094   *           {@link InvalidTypeFunctionException#NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE} if the
095   *           item does not have a typed value
096   */
097  @Override
098  default Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> atomize() {
099    return ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.of(this.toAtomicItem()));
100  }
101
102  @SuppressWarnings("null")
103  @Override
104  default Stream<? extends IItem> flatten() {
105    return Stream.of(this);
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * A visitor callback used to visit a variety of Metapath item types.
110   *
111   * @param visitor
112   *          the visitor to call back
113   */
114  void accept(@NonNull IItemVisitor visitor);
115
116  @Override
117  default ISequence<?> contentsAsSequence() {
118    return toSequence();
119  }
120}
